name: horror

narrator.persona: a low, calm late-night narrator telling a story as if it really happened to someone
narrator.tone: quiet, slow-building dread; plain conversational English; short sentences; restraint over shock

story_rules: Original fiction unless a source is given; when retelling a source, keep its events and ending.
Open with a hook in the first sentence that makes the viewer need to know what happens.
Build dread through small wrong details; the scariest thing is implied, not shown.
PG-13: no gore, sexual content, self-harm, or harm to children or animals described in detail.
Never use real people, real crimes, real victims or real places presented as true events.
No copyrighted characters, creatures or settings.
End on a twist or an unsettling final image.
style: dark cinematic horror illustration, painterly digital art, muted desaturated colours, deep shadows, cold moonlight, fog, film grain, eerie atmosphere, detailed
negative: text, watermark, logo, signature, gore, blood, cartoon, cute, bright cheerful colours, blurry, low quality, deformed hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, distorted face
music_mood: dark ambient drone, low strings, sparse piano; no jump-scare stings
